experiments.hypothesis: Three-judge panel (tone + IP + narrative) catches >90% of bad-ship moments before publication.
experiments.metric: post-incident survey: count cases where a published post was retracted or required correction within 24h, divided by total ships
experiments.notes: Baseline: pre-rule, manual self-review missed at least three IP near-misses + multiple tone misfires.

experiments.hypothesis: Cheap Haiku judge calls cost less than the value of one prevented retraction.
experiments.metric: monthly token spend on judge calls vs incidents prevented
experiments.notes: If <$5/month and prevents one issue, 3D-Execution Axiom says ship it indefinitely.

experiments.hypothesis: Soft-fail mode (WARN when API key missing) keeps the gate usable in offline / cost-sensitive sessions without compromising shipped artifacts.
experiments.metric: ratio of (WARN due to missing API key) to (PASS) over 30d; should stay <10%
experiments.notes: If ratio climbs, switch judges to local Ollama Haiku-class model.
